description: Is RSV going around? Returns weekly new hospital admissions for laboratory-confirmed RSV, split into children and adults, plus patients in hospital and ICU and the season-to-date total, nationally or for one state, from CDC's NHSN Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data. Useful for parents of infants, paediatric services and reporters each autumn and winter. Hospital data only; it does not count community infections. (cost: 1 credit)

jurisdiction.description: string, optional, USA or 2-letter state/territory code, default USA

weeks.description: integer, optional, 1-52 most recent weeks, default 4

name: rsv_hospital_admissions_weekly
